0.original: Alphinaud is ready to lead the way to Radiata.

24.original: Stay alert for imperial soldiers on the way to Specula Imperatoris.

25.original: Enter Specula Imperatoris and stay alert for imperial soldiers.

27.original: Stay alert for imperial soldiers on the way to Radiata.

48.original: Hm! I knew the Alliance had spies in Gyr Abania, but in Radiata? Impressive...

49.original: ...I suspect a handpicked contingent of the Ala Mhigan Brigade's finest would have been equally, if not more, qualified...but what do I know.

50.original: Perhaps you recall the night we first met outside the Sil'dihn ruins, under such unfortunate circumstances? I had just returned from a meeting with my Ala Mhigan agents. As I said before, we have been preparing for this day.

51.original: We have lost so many men already... If we suffer another defeat like that, this campaign is over.

52.original: We will have our retribution. It is but a matter of time.

53.original: Had Alphinaud not volunteered you, I would have asked. If anyone can see this mission through, it's you.

54.original: We'll be fighting with the main host when the time comes to attack Castrum Abania. I swear by everything that is holy─we won't lose!

55.original: There you go again, getting all worked up...though it could be worse. So long as you don't start saying bollocks like, “I'll never forgive them!” Makes for a terrible battle cry, you know?

56.original: Many of the J tribe call this place home. I shudder to think what would become of them if we fail.

57.original: Thanks for standing by me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Together, we'll make Conrad proud!

58.original: So, to review: we are to travel to Radiata, where we will meet with a contact recruited by Marshal Tarupin's agents.

59.original: I took the liberty of reviewing intelligence reports while <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> and Lyse were away, so the settlement is not wholly unfamiliar to me...

60.original: As the vice marshal indicated, the vast majority of the populace is employed as menial labor in either Specula Imperatoris or Castrum Abania. Perhaps as a result of this, the Resistance has long struggled to make inroads there.

61.original: Aye, you have the right of it. They got a better deal than most Ala Mhigans─feeding off what scraps the imperials gave 'em. Damned if I know how Marshal Tarupin's agents got one of them to turn his coat.

62.original: I understand your disdain, I do. But I also understand their desire to look after their families by any means necessary...

63.original: Our contact is a Roegadyn woman. She will ask us a question. After we answer with “courage,” she will know us as friends.

64.original: "Courage.“ Right.<hex:02100103>Put together a squadron, Naago. We'll need them soon.

65.original: With me, my friends─and be ready for anything.

66.original: Keep an eye out, would you? Something doesn't feel right...

68.original: If there were magitek armor nearby, surely we would have heard them by now?

69.original: See? What did I tell you? Let us continue on to Specula Imperatoris!

71.original: Whew. That would have been an unceremonious ending to our tale.

73.original: Of course there were still soldiers lurking about... Fortunately, they were no match for Lyse. Come─Radiata is not much further.

74.original: Of course, in light of our recent encounter, it would be prudent to proceed with caution and remain vigilant for imperial forces...

75.original: I thought they said this was a village? It looks more like a work camp...

76.original: Nary a soldier in sight. Mayhap they were recalled to Castrum Abania...

77.original: Looks like it's safe to enter. I don't see any imperials...

78.original: Hmm... I don't see smoke above Castrum Abania anymore. Do you think they fixed the cannon already...?
